description: Unavailable: Premiere's documented ExtendScript and UXP APIs have no setter for a timeline clip's speed (only getters), and the undocumented QE setSpeed is deliberately not used. Always fails before mutation. To change how long a clip runs on the timeline, use set_clip_duration.

speed_percent.description: Speed as percentage (100 = normal, 200 = 2x, 50 = half speed)
